mcqs.question: During a Weber tuning fork test, lateralization of sound to the diseased ear with a negative Rinne test indicates:
options: Sensorineural hearing loss in that ear
Conductive hearing loss in that ear
mcqs.explanation: In conductive hearing loss, bone conduction exceeds air conduction (negative Rinne: BC > AC), and sound lateralizes to the affected ear.
